justification: Copy-only change to the builder demo page (/widget-demo/[slug]): leads with the removed-labour-step reframe from the 2026-07-20 builder workflow research instead of the lead-gen framing, renames the three result buckets, and adds an explicit not-covered panel (sewer/easements/covenants). No logic, no data, no new fields.

pre_impl.existing_data: Grounded in two verified research passes on 2026-07-20: a workflow study of Sydney duplex builders (free same-day site assessment is universal; monetisation starts at tender; ~21 manual lookups per site) and a code audit of what the engine actually returns. Copy claims only capabilities the audit confirmed: per-address eligibility with clause/page citations, the unconfirmed three-state, per-council DCP controls.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The audit killed three angles that earlier copy drafts flirted with: suburb-level eligible-stock aggregates (bulk index still serves corrupt FSR-derived yields), refusal-pattern insight (DA layer frozen at 2023-04, no refusal reasons exist), and naming any binding control beyond FSR or height. None of those appear in this copy. The not-covered panel states the sewer/easement/covenant gap rather than letting a builder assume coverage.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: No new capability and no new claim: the three-bucket framing renames what the widget already renders (eligible / clear no / indeterminate). The council-variation panel invites the builder to test their own councils rather than asserting a comparison we would have to substantiate in copy.

functions: N/A - copy-only change; no function added, changed, or removed.
values: N/A - no DB or API values involved; static JSX strings only.
queries: N/A - no database access in this change.

break_it.scenario: The 'sorts enquiries three ways' copy over-promises a triage the widget does not actually render, so a builder installs it and sees only yes/no.
break_it.what_happens: The pitch's central claim visibly fails on their own site during the pilot.
break_it.how: The three buckets map exactly to states already shipped in DuplexCheckWidget: dualOccEligible true, clear no, and the indeterminate branch added in PR #790. No copy describes a state the component cannot render.
break_it.repro: Run an eligible, an ineligible and an unconfirmed address on any /widget-demo page - three visually distinct cards.

break_it.scenario: The 'cited to the clause and page' claim is stated for councils where page-level citation does not exist, so a builder checks a citation and finds nothing.
break_it.what_happens: The credibility claim that carries the whole pitch fails on inspection.
break_it.how: Audit confirmed the DCP control corpus is 100% cited to section_ref/pdf_page across the covered councils. Copy makes no coverage-count claim, so a builder outside the covered set sees fewer controls rather than a broken citation.
break_it.repro: Run a covered-council address and follow a control back to its section reference.

break_it.scenario: A builder reads the council-variation panel as us asserting their published frontage minimums are wrong, and takes offence.
break_it.what_happens: Relationship damage with a prospect at first contact.
break_it.how: The panel states only that controls vary by council and invites them to test their own; it makes no comparison to the builder's own published figures. The demonstration-not-assertion rule lives in the outreach doc for use on calls, not in on-page copy.
break_it.repro: Read the 'Council by council' panel - no second-person claim about their content.
